name: Y Wladfa (Patagonia)
blurb: The Welsh in Patagonia since 1865: chapels, tea houses and Welsh spoken in Gaiman. Airliners via Buenos Aires.
flight_line: The RAF doesn't fly to Argentina, so the movements officer books you onto airliners: London to Buenos Aires overnight, then a small plane south to Trelew. A remis runs you up the valley past poplars and brick chapels. Croeso i'r Wladfa. Bienvenidos.
